sources.fullCitation: Bibliothèque nationale de France, notice de personne “Roubier d'Hérembault, André-Paul (18..-1961)”, FRBNF14842949, ark:/12148/cb148429497. Male, composer and lyricist, birth undetermined in the nineteenth century, death in 1961, recorded from SACEM in 1980, with the rejected forms “Charline, Paul (18..-1961)”, a pseudonym, and “Hérembault, André-Paul Roubier d'”. ISNI 0000 0000 1013 0301. This remains only a candidate identification for André Roubier: the uncommon surname, period and professional milieu agree, but BnF's single linked bibliographic record, the 1937 film song “Un carnet de bal / Valse grise”, credits him as lyricist under the name Paul Charline, whereas the linked Kaper records identify André Roubier as a composer. The BnF disc notice for “À Paris, tiguidiguidi” names neither Roubier nor any composer, crediting only Henri Garat as singer and Bronisław Kaper as conductor. No identity resolution is asserted. Accessed 2 August 2026.
